site.title: Call me Davy
site.description: Advertising to make you feel, art to make you think. Made by Davy Mellado.

bio.short: Polymath. Philosopher. Photographer. Davy Mellado engineers emotion into rationality — building creative engines for brands, cameras, and communities that make reality more beautifully functional.
bio.long:
Davy Mellado is a polymath working across photography, advertising, product, and philosophy — a National Geographic-credited shooter, a Hershey and UberFacts creative brain, the founder of CLR Wear (an automated custom-fit apparel platform), and a Johns Hopkins researcher who studies bias not as contamination but as a directional force that can de-weaponize disagreement.

They've built creative engines that produced more impact with less burnout — a proof-of-concept that efficiency can be both ethical and aesthetic. As a photographer, Davy treats the camera as an instrument of argument: visual persuasion deployed with precision, whether it's an executive portrait, a vigil, a landscape at 4am, or a chocolate bar under studio lights.

Raised inside a $60M church, trained in theater, sharpened by pragmatist philosophy (Dewey, West), and always chasing juxtaposition as method — Davy makes work that treats the sacred as domestic and the everyday as sacred. Compressing complexity, revealing leverage, making reality more beautifully functional.

Based in Media, Pennsylvania. Open to collaboration on the strange, the useful, and the true.
